positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Single-handedly drove a GraphQL schema migration spanning 200+ types and 40+ queries/mutations, unblocking a critical Rails 6-to-7 framework upgrade across the core monolith.
- Led full-stack development of Progressive Filtering (GraphQL + Elasticsearch), enabling near-real-time faceted search with live result counts across 100K+ contract documents, replacing a limited static filter system.
- Designed and scaled a saved-search system into an automated scheduled reporting pipeline, generating 1,000+ reports weekly across hundreds of customer organizations.
- Built "Simulation Mode" for bulk contract actions, enabling users to preview and validate changes across 10K+ records via CSV before committing, eliminating data corruption risks that previously required manual engineering investigation.
- Partnered with Data Science to ship "Similarity Terms," architecting infrastructure for natural language clause matching across legal agreements.
- Refactored contract termination date logic to resolve a long-standing pain point, improving clarity of expiration data across the platform and reducing customer support escalations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead developer on a React Native application with about 80k daily active users. Mostly Javascript with some native iOS/Android.
• Worked on two Ruby on Rails web applications and a few Ruby Gems. Familiar with ActiveAdmin and Rspec.
• Wrote and used REST endpoints as well as GraphQL queries and mutations.
• Designed and managed a project to replace an outdated pin login system with username/password authentication.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Deployed Elasticsearch, Cassandra, and OrientDB to Docker Swarm. 
• Built Jenkins pipelines to build Java applications and run code analysis using SonarQube. 
• Developed a REST API to serve healthcare policy data and convert XML to JSON. 
• Created a voice application for Google Assistant to answer questions regarding HSAs.

volunteerExperiences.description: Examined the issue of hunger in the Greater Boston Area. Worked at urban farms and soup kitchens to grow and distribute organic food to the local community. The goal of this project was to solve the issue of hunger by increasing the accessibility of locally produced organic food and supporting urban farmers.

projects.title: Revival of the Phi Chi Theta Zeta Chapter
projects.description: Working with other students with similar interest in professionalism, business and networking to bring a third option of a Business Fraternity to the Boston University campus.  Communicating using various methods to create the constitution, pledging process, and other aspects of the fraternity, we aim to continue the strong traditions of Phi Chi Theta and enrich the community of Boston University with the revival of a fraternity lost many years ago.
